{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, removing commas
df['revenue_numeric'] = df['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify and exclude QA test orders (revenue = 999999.99)
qa_mask = df['revenue_numeric'] == 999999.99

# Identify and exclude refunded orders
refunded_mask = df['status'] == 'refunded'

# Filter: only completed orders, excluding QA and refunded
filtered_df = df[~refunded_mask & ~qa_mask]

# Group by channel and sum revenue
revenue_by_channel = filtered_df.groupby('channel')['revenue_numeric'].sum()

# Find the channel with the highest total revenue
best_channel = revenue_by_channel.idxmax()
best_revenue = revenue_by_channel.max()

# Confirm only two channels exist
print(f"Actual channels in data: {df['channel'].unique()}")
print(f"Revenue by channel (filtered):\n{revenue_by_channel}")
print(f"Channel with highest revenue: {best_channel} with {best_revenue:,.2f} USD")

# Return the result for submission
best_channel, best_revenue"}
